context:
Goal: the Recovered guard accepts the carry-line form that the report rules teach.
Problem (rule): the guard now counts `- OTHER: Recovered: x (git)` (a bullet, then the Done tag). It still refuses the label-first form `**Done** OTHER: Recovered: x (git)`. Counting that form too would add a second accepted form to a shared tool, which needs your word.
Based on (read): the round 1 reviewer of PR 3456 found the label-first form refused and the bullet form passing (lint/report_guard.py, CARRY_START). Triage read the lane's message, not the code.
Based on (ruling): your 23:50 CST Nov 14 "we need to fix the guard" (step recovered-guard-remedy; the meaning is the consultant's reading). Your earlier cull ruling r5 covers wrong refusals of the Recovered line (15:18 CST Nov 10: "A is fine ..."); it does not say whether a second form is accepted.
Departs from: main refuses `- OTHER: Recovered: ...`; PR 3456 accepts it; the label-first form stays refused.
Meanwhile: the lane keeps PR 3456 as it is (a draft, handed in to its coordinator). Nothing else waits.

options.gain: No second form; the guard stays as PR 3456 has it.
options.label: Keep the guard as PR 3456 has it: sessions use the bullet form
options.lose: A session that writes the label-first form is refused once.

options.gain: One tag rule: both forms count.
options.label: Accept the label-first form too
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
